name: Luomu Yuge
source:
As a college student renting in Huazhuo Residential Area, you begin to sense something unsettling beneath its ordinary surface. Slowly, the eerie atmosphere seeps into your daily life, pulling you into a hidden conspiracy—until you uncover its terrifying truth.
